related.title: Linux 核心移植
related.why: 裝置樹與平臺資源必須銜接
related.transfer: 裝置樹與平臺資源必須銜接
related.difference: 平臺移植建立環境，驅動實作裝置生命週期
related.differenceEn: Porting establishes context; drivers implement lifecycle
practice: 由「裝置匹配」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「平臺移植建立環境，驅動實作裝置生命週期」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From device matching, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "Porting establishes context; drivers implement lifecycle", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.
